味.story: Your **mouth** (口) is **not yet** (未) sure what it is eating until the first bite reveals its **taste**.

写.story: Under a dark **cover** (冖) cloth, an old camera **bestows** (与) a perfect image on every subject: it can **copy** anything.

字.story: Under the **roof** (宀) of a schoolhouse, a **child** (子) traces stroke after stroke until each **character** looks just right.

答.story: The teacher's **bamboo** (竹) pointer taps the one puzzle piece that **fits** (合): that is the right **answer**.

夜.story: When **evening** (夕) puts a **lid** (亠) on the sky, a **person** (亻) hurries home through the dark **night**.

注.story: A thirsty **lord** (主) holds out his golden cup as a servant tips a jug of **water** (氵) to **pour**.

帰.story: After a long day, Mum hangs up her kitchen **knife** (刂) and her **broom** (帚) and sets off to **return home**.

歌.story: **Big brother** (哥) has a **lack** (欠) of talent, but he still opens his mouth wide and belts out a **song**.

買.story: At the seaside market you hold out a **net** (罒) bag and fill it with fresh **shellfish** (貝) you **buy**.

悪.story: Coming **next** (亜) after the winner sours the runner-up's **heart** (心), and he feels **bad** all day.

図.story: Inside an **enclosure** (囗) of paper, **small** (⺍) dots and a big X (乂) show where the treasure lies on this **map**.

週.story: **Walk** (⻌) the full **circumference** (周) of the calendar, Monday round to Sunday, and you have finished a **week**.

室.story: Under the **roof** (宀), guests **arrive** (至) and are shown into a cosy **room**.

歩.story: **Stop** (止), take a **few** (少) wobbly steps, stop again: that is how a toddler learns to **walk**.

風.story: A gust sweeps across the picnic **table** (几) and sends a tiny **insect** (虫) tumbling away on the **wind**.

紙.story: Each family **clan** (氏) presses plant **threads** (糸) flat and dries them in the sun to make **paper**.

黒.story: A **village** (里) bonfire (灬) burns all night, and by morning every wall is coated in **black** soot.

花.story: A green **grass** (艹) bud goes through a magical **change** (化) and opens into a **flower**.

春.story: Three people (𡗗) stretch out under the warm **day** (日) sunshine, glad that **spring** has finally arrived.

赤.story: A heap of **soil** (土) sits over a crackling campfire, and the coals beneath it glow bright **red**.

青.story: Fresh sprouts (龶) grow in the light of the **moon** (月), tinting the whole field a cool **blue**.

館.story: Where do **bureaucrats** (官) gather to **eat** (飠) at grand banquets? Inside a large public **building**.

屋.story: Worn out from walking, shoppers **arrive** (至) and flop like a **corpse** (尸) onto the bench of a little **shop**.

色.story: A **wrapping** (𠂊) of ribbon twists around a swirly **comma-design** (巴), splashing it with every bright **color**.

秋.story: Ripe **grain** (禾) glows orange like **fire** (火) across the fields at harvest time in **autumn**.

夏.story: Get **one** (一) day off and you take **yourself** (自) and **go** (夂) straight to the beach: that is **summer**.

習.story: A baby bird flaps its **white** (白) **feathers** (羽) again and again as it tries to **learn** to fly.

駅.story: Travellers count the road **foot** (尺) by foot until their tired **horse** (馬) reaches the next **station**.

洋.story: A flock of **sheep** (羊) sails across the **water** (氵) on a great wooden ship, crossing the wide **ocean**.

旅.story: With a compass showing the **direction** (方), a **person** (亻) shoulders a pack and sets off on a long **trip**.

服.story: Every **month** (月), my **right hand** (又) presses a wax **seal** (卩) onto a parcel of new **clothing**.

借.story: **Once upon a time** (昔), a **person** (亻) knocked on your door with a polite question: may I **borrow** this?

曜.story: Each **day** (日), a different **pheasant** (翟) struts past your window, so you always know which **weekday** it is.

飲.story: After you **eat** (飠), there is a **lack** (欠) of something wet in your throat, so you open wide and **drink**.

貸.story: Your wallet is empty, so a friend offers **shellfish** (貝) coins as a **substitute** (代) for cash: his to **lend**.

堂.story: On solid **soil** (土), the townspeople build a place they hold in high **esteem** (尚): their grand public **hall**.

鳥.story: An eye on top, a plump body, and four flicks of **fire** (灬) below for tail feathers: a **bird** ready to fly.

飯.story: Even a kid who is **anti** (反) vegetables will happily **eat** (飠) a hot bowl of rice at every **meal**.

勉.story: No **excuses** (免)! Pour all your **power** (力) into your homework, because study takes real **exertion**.

昼.story: The sun climbs one **foot** (尺) at a time from **daybreak** (旦) until it stands high overhead at **noon**.

茶.story: A **person** (人) stands between a **tree** (木) and fresh **grass** (艹) shoots, picking young leaves to brew **tea**.

弟.story: Aged **eight** (八), he wails in **mourning** (弔) over a lost toy, one tear (丿) streaking down: my **younger brother**.

魚.story: Caught in a flooded **rice field** (田), it is **wrapped** (𠂊) in leaves and grilled over a **fire** (灬): dinner is **fish**.

犬.story: A **large** (大) figure with one little **dot** (丶) by its ear: a big **dog** sitting up with one ear cocked.

妹.story: She is a **woman** (女) **not yet** (未) grown up, still borrowing my shoes: my **younger sister**.

姉.story: The **woman** (女) who drags me to the **market** (市) and haggles on my behalf is my **elder sister**.

漢.story: Beside the **water** (氵), a **husband** (夫) sits on the **grass** (艹) and reads an old scroll aloud with his **mouth** (口), every word from **China**.

政.story: Leaders **strike** (攵) the table, each insisting their own plan is **correct** (正): welcome to **politics**.

議.story: Everyone **says** (言) what they believe is **righteous** (義), and the room settles into long **deliberation**.

民.story: Many a small **clan** (氏) joins together under one flag to form the **people** of a nation.

連.story: As you **walk** (⻌), a toy **car** (車) on a string rolls behind you: it is the one thing you always **take along**.

部.story: The **village** (⻏) chief **spits out** (咅) orders, splitting everyone into teams, each with its own **section**.

合.story: A **person** (人) presses **one** (一) lid down onto the **mouth** (口) of a jar, and it is a perfect **fit**.

内.story: A **person** (人) ducks under an **upside-down box** (冂) to hide, snug and safe **inside**.

相.story: Two friends peek out from behind a **tree** (木) and meet **eye** (目) to eye: a **mutual** surprise.

定.story: Under the **roof** (宀), siblings squabble over one **bolt of cloth** (疋) until Grandma steps in to **determine** who gets it.

回.story: A little **mouth** (口) spins inside a big **enclosure** (囗), lap after lap, going **round** and round.

共.story: Two posts joined by crossbars rest on the splayed legs of an **eight** (八), like friends carrying a bench **together**.

選.story: Voters **walk** (⻌) to the polling booth in the **southeast** (巽) corner of town to **elect** a new mayor.

米.story: Four tiny grains fly off a cross-shaped stalk in every direction, like a sheaf being threshed: a picture of **rice**.

実.story: Under the **roof** (宀), a farmer piles high his harvest (𡗗) of ripe fruit: his dream has become **reality**.

関.story: A heavy **gate** (門) at the **frontier pass** (关) is the only **connection** between two kingdoms.

決.story: At the edge of icy **water** (氵), you count to three, because now is the moment to **decide**.

王.story: Three stacked floors of a palace pierced by one central pillar: the tower where the **king** lives.

全.story: A **person** (人) holds a giant umbrella over the **king** (王) and his land so the kingdom stays dry and **whole**.

表.story: A **garment** (衣) with **two** (二) stripes and a **line** (丨) of buttons shows off its outer **surface**.

単.story: Just one **small** (⺍) decoration on plain **armor** (甲): nothing fancy, nice and **simple**.

戦.story: Hand a **simple** (単) farmer a **halberd** (戈) and march him to the front: that is **war**.

経.story: A **holy** (圣) monk winds a long scroll on silk **thread** (糸), letting the years **pass through** his fingers.

耳.story: Picture an **ear** from the side: a tall frame with two ridges inside and a lobe sticking out at the bottom.

取.story: A pencil tucked behind your **ear** (耳)? Your **right hand** (又) reaches up to **take** it.

最.story: Every **day** (日) you **take** (取) the biggest slice of cake, because you always want the **most**.

現.story: When the **king** (王) finally steps out, everyone can **see** (見) him with their own eyes: he is truly **present**.

調.story: The choir **says** (言) each note over and over, circling the whole **circumference** (周) of the scale until it is in **tune**.

化.story: A **person** (亻) stirs a bubbling potion with a magic **spoon** (匕) and suddenly goes through a strange **change**.

当.story: A **small** (⺌) beanbag sails across the fairground and bounces off a painted pig's **snout** (⺕): a direct **hit**!

約.story: Tie a **thread** (糸) around the soup **ladle** (勺) so you never forget your **promise**.

首.story: Two tufts of hair stick up above a face, **oneself** (自), and that whole head balances on your **neck**.

法.story: When the **water** (氵) is nearly **gone** (去), the village elders write a strict **law** for sharing what is left.

性.story: The **heart** (忄) you carry from the start of your **life** (生) shapes your true **nature**.

要.story: Packing light, a **woman** (女) snaps the **cover** (覀) shut on her suitcase, keeping only what she will **need**.

制.story: Each dawn the farmer milks the **cow** (牛), folds the **cloth** (巾) and sharpens the **knife** (刂): his day runs on a strict **system**.

治.story: Standing on a stone **pedestal** (台) by the river, the ruler keeps the flood **water** (氵) in check: a calm **reign**.

予.story: Tie the knot (マ) on your parcel early, so the job is **complete** (了) well **beforehand**.

務.story: A guard grips his **spear** (矛), ready to **strike** (攵) with all his **power** (力): guarding the gate is his **duty**.

成.story: A young squire **wraps** (𠂊) his hand around a **halberd** (戈) for the first time; with practice, a knight is what he will **become**.

期.story: **That** (其) **month** (月) circled in red on the calendar marks the end of the school **period**.

都.story: **Someone** (者) from every **village** (⻏) moves to the big city, until it swells into the **capital**.

和.story: When there is **grain** (禾) for every **mouth** (口), the whole village lives in **harmony**.

幾.story: Guards on **protection** (戍) duty tie a **short thread** (幺) knot for each rider they spot, counting **how many** came.

機.story: From one **tree** (木), carpenters carve **how many** (幾) gears? Hundreds, enough to build a whole **machine**.

平.story: A sheet is spread out to **dry** (干), two pegs on top pinning it down so it lies perfectly **flat**.

加.story: Each cheering **mouth** (口) gives the team more **power** (力), so every voice you **add** counts.

受.story: From above, a **claw** (⺤) lowers a gift with a **cover** (冖) into an open **right hand** (又), ready to **accept** it.
